items.title: Puka Nacua: Returns after brief exit
items.text:
Nacua returned to Sunday's game against the Commanders after visiting the medical tent, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

items.title: Michael Penix: Held in check through air by Bengals
items.text:
Penix completed 20 of 31 passes for 162 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 34-17 loss to Cincinnati. He added 50 rushing yards on three carries.
